source.description: Written by Ekos Labs. Uses the Ekos MCP connection; no upstream skill files are bundled.

dependencies: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw or another agent that can run shell commands (sign-up in the chat), or Claude, ChatGPT, Grok or another MCP client with OAuth sign-in
A free Ekos account, created in the chat with the user's work email and a 6-digit code, or by signing in through the connection
